adobe_analytics_configurations.description: The list of configurations of tables you want to sync. The number of tables and their configurations is limited to 5. Required for connector creation.

calculated_metrics.description: The calculated_metrics that you want to sync.

elements.description: The elements that you want to sync.

metrics.description: The metrics that you want to sync.

report_suites.description: Specific report suites to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificReportSuites`.

segments.description: The segments that you want to sync.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all report suites or specific report suites. Default value: `AllReportSuites` .

table.description: The table name unique within the schema to which connector will sync the data. Required for connector creation.

items.description: The list of configurations of tables you want to sync. The number of tables and their configurations is limited to 5. Required for connector creation.

client_id.description: Client ID from the OAuth Server-to-Server credentials of your Adobe Project.

client_secret.description: Client Secret from the OAuth Server-to-Server credentials of your Adobe Project.

date_granularity.description: The aggregation duration you want. Default value: `HOUR` .

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector has been created. Default value: `TWELVE` .
